title: Wendell and the Lantern
author: Jude Montrose
blurb: Yara Montrose, a typeface cutter's daughter in a print shop on the eve of a revolution, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. But when a sealed letter names the family in a plot no one wants a part of, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must choose which family member gets the last berth before the ice breaks on the river.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
